answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 46827 Country: India Title: will (wasiyat) Question: Will or wasiyat by a Muslim in favour of his legal (Quranic) heir (waris) is legal or illegal? Answer ID: 46827 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1106/1113/M=9/1434) Those who inherit as per the Shariah may not be entitled to a will (wasiyat). So a person getting share as heir may not be nominated for a will, as the Prophet (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) said: لا وصیۃ لوارث Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
